description: This file defines the ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner class, which extends TransactionTestRunnerBase and provides methods to perform various transaction tests involving fault injection on grains within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for single grain read/write transactions and multi-grain fault-injected transactions, handling exceptions and retries.

classes.name: ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for executing transaction tests with fault injection in Orleans grains, supporting single and multi-grain transactions with fault scenarios.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read transaction on a single grain, verifying the value before and after deactivation.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a single grain, adding a delta and verifying the updated value.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction_FaultInjection
methods.description: Performs a multi-grain transaction with fault injection, handling exceptions and retries, and verifying final state.
